title: Retransmitted batches: identical replay and a content conflict
description: After the normal uploads, station S1 re-sends its first batch byte-for-byte (must be counted as a duplicate and change nothing), then re-sends the record with source_seq 7 carrying a different uncertainty under the same sequence number (must land in the conflict table and leave the original untouched). Events and counts must be identical with and without the retransmission.
